claims.summary: 1994-06-01 Legends 307 first printing, Nicola Leonard; current Oracle legendary land, no printed mana ability.
Each creature is given its own controller-upkeep trigger, paid independently; unpaid creatures are destroyed rather than sacrificed. Trigger is not an activation of Tabernacle.
Jarvis Yu 2015 Grand Prix Seattle-Tacoma winner Lands 60/15 with 1 Tabernacle, 4 Crop Rotation, 4 Port, 4 Wasteland, 3 Maze, 4 Life from the Loam.
Winning player published a detailed Lands primer on December 2, 2015, after tournament; distinguish proposed future variant from the exact winning registered list.
Contemporary recap mentions Tabernacle in finals game one, but new vignette's exact crop-rotation/tokens/play decisions are fictional rather than a sourced match transcript.
